name: tidepools-mcp

tools.name: get_journal_entries
tools.description: Retrieve Tidepools journal entries by date range.

endDate.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Retrieve a Tidepools page by exact title.

tools.name: edit_page
tools.description:
Edit a non-journal page. Provide either replacements or edits. replacements (preferred) are find-and-replace edits applied in order; each oldText must occur exactly once in the current content, so include enough surrounding text to make it unique. With replacements, expectedRevisionNumber is optional: omit it to apply the edit to the latest content, or pass it to fail if the page changed. edits are 1-based inclusive line ranges and require expectedRevisionNumber. Tidepools pages use a markdown-like format:
- Todos are markdown bullet points whose text starts with one of these statuses: TODO, DOING, NOW, LATER, DONE, WAITING, CANCELLED. Examples: "- NOW write docs", "- LATER call mom", "- DONE make a cake", "- CANCELLED book flights".
- Formulas are bullet points whose text starts with "=". Example: "- =ask("question")". Preserve formula lines unless the user explicitly asks to edit them.
- Wiki links use [[Page Title]] syntax. Preserve this syntax when referencing or editing links.
- When editing existing content, keep newText and replacementText as raw Tidepools markdown only. Do not include line-number prefixes such as "12: ".
- Prefer minimal find-and-replace edits and preserve surrounding indentation, bullets, todo status labels, formulas, and links unless the requested change requires modifying them.
- To change a todo's status, text, or dates, prefer search_todos and edit_todo.

oldText.description: Exact text to replace; must occur exactly once in the current content

tools.name: append_to_today_journal
tools.description:
Append markdown text to today's Tidepools journal entry. If page_tag is set, append as a subbullet under the last top-level bullet that wikilinks to that page, creating "- [[page_tag]]" at the end when it is missing. Tidepools pages use a markdown-like format:
- Todos are markdown bullet points whose text starts with one of these statuses: TODO, DOING, NOW, LATER, DONE, WAITING, CANCELLED. Examples: "- NOW write docs", "- LATER call mom", "- DONE make a cake", "- CANCELLED book flights".

- Wiki links use [[Page Title]] syntax. Preserve this syntax when referencing or editing links.
- When editing existing content, keep newText and replacementText as raw Tidepools markdown only. Do not include line-number prefixes such as "12: ".
- Prefer minimal find-and-replace edits and preserve surrounding indentation, bullets, todo status labels, formulas, and links unless the requested change requires modifying them.
- To change a todo's status, text, or dates, prefer search_todos and edit_todo.

page_tag.description: Optional page title. When set, append text as a subbullet under the last top-level "- [[page_tag]]" bullet, creating that bullet if needed.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: BM25 search across Tidepools pages and journal entries.

tools.name: search_todos
tools.description: Search Tidepools todos by text and/or status.

tools.name: create_todo
tools.description: Append a new todo to today's Tidepools journal entry. Todo text should not include the leading "- STATUS"; provide text separately from the optional status.

tools.name: edit_todo
tools.description: Edit a todo returned by search_todos using its stale-safe todoId: change its status, text, scheduled date, or deadline. Edits elsewhere on the same page do not cause conflicts; the edit fails only if this todo changed since it was read. Text must not include the leading status label or date tags; dates are set with scheduledDate/deadlineDate (YYYY-MM-DD, or null to remove) and existing date tags are kept when only the text changes. Returns the todo's new todoId for follow-up edits.

expectedRevisionNumber.description: Deprecated and ignored; the todoId detects stale todos

scheduledDate.description: Scheduled date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null to remove it

deadlineDate.description: Deadline in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null to remove it
